title: Thai Beef Tagine
description: A fusion of Thai and North African flavors, this dish combines the warmth of tagine spices with the bold flavors of Thai cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in large pan over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from pan and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pan and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add fish sauce and brown sugar to pan and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pan and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Add lemon juice to pan and stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until beef is cooked to desired level of doneness.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
